prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for the following target group: people with intellectual disabilities (Down syndrome, development delay, etc.). Rewrite the text in easy language to make it easily understandable for them.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are very important for studying the brain. Scientists use mice because they are easy to manage and help them learn about how the brain works. In the past, scientists mostly used male mice in their studies. This is because they were worried that female mice might act differently because of their hormones, which could change the results.
